understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete every level by moving each selectable piece onto a goal tile marked +; all goals must be occupied simultaneously for a level to register as won.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces move in 3-pixel grid increments, with movement sometimes blocked by walls or boundaries. Adjacent pushable blocks can potentially be moved by pushing, while walls obstruct movement. CLICK selects a selectable piece using its pixel-coordinate position, though clicks on unavailable or blocked targets may not change selection. Movement hints are heuristic, so actions must be tested directly.
